intro.title: White Sapphire Stone
intro.description: The White Sapphire stone is the colorless Sapphire gemstone. It is a precious and popular gemstone for jewelry because of its similarity in appearance to Diamond. The silvery shine makes it a sought-after stone for all types of White Sapphire jewelry, as it looks sparkling beautiful. The energy of Venus and Neptune are present in White Sapphire, making it a unique gemstone with powerful properties in both the material and spiritual realms.

tabs.tab1_description:
White Sapphire gemstone is a precious gemstone that is a member of the corundum mineral family, just like the most commonly known blue sapphire or ruby. White Sapphire hardness is 9 on the Mohs scale, therefore, making it the second hardest gemstone after diamonds. Despite the fact that white sapphire is prized primarily for its beauty and rarity, it also possesses exceptional healing properties. White sapphire is recurrently connected to spiritual development and enlightenment. It is believed to help align one's spiritual and physical aspects, fostering a sense of harmony and equilibrium. Certain people use white sapphire to strengthen their spiritual practices and connect with their higher selves.

White sapphire improves mental clarity, concentration, and focus. It stimulates the mind, enhances memory, and fosters rational thought. Due to its calming, inspiring, and soothing effect on emotions, some individuals use white sapphire as a tool to hone their Venusian musical talents and raise up their artistic nature. It eases the release of negative emotions, alleviates anxiety, and supports emotional wellness. It is believed that white sapphire has protective properties and can help ward off evil forces. It provides protection against psychic attacks and mental disturbances, as well as negative influences. In addition, some individuals use white sapphire to cleanse and clear their energy fields.

White Sapphire stone is significant in Vedic Astrology, as it carries the vibrations of the planet Neptune, which is said to be a planet with creative imagination and the highest spiritual potential. Indeed, the spiritual vibrations of this planet alone are high and not everyone can harness them. Therefore, white sapphire gemstone is advised to be worn by Vedic Astrologers to either harness the high spiritual heights of Neptune or nullify any possible negative effect of a misplaced or weakened Neptune at birth.

White Sapphire stone activates the pineal and pituitary glands and is useful for identifying alternative or past-life influences on present-day diseases. It is also useful for mustering the courage to cross the veil when it is time to leave the physical world. White Sapphire revitalizes the less active energy meridians in the brain, thereby enhancing your capacity to tune in to spirit guides, angels, and even humans who have "crossed over." White Sapphire enhances a person's psychic abilities, particularly their ability to channel high-frequency energy or information, or to communicate with superior beings or God.

Another attractive aspect of the White Sapphire stone is the few White Star Sapphire that are available. The White Star Sapphire are White Sapphire stones that give a reflection of 6 rays when light falls on it from a precise angle. Known as Asterism, this is an optical phenomenon, which takes place due to the presence of very fine needle-like or rather a silk thread-like inclusions in the gemstone, that reflect the mesmerizing six rays, a star-like pattern when light hits it from a certain angle.

The White Star Sapphire is very rarely available and therefore is highly valued. White Star Sapphire is a symbol of unconditional and enduring love. It is ideal for exchange between first lovers who have sacrificed everything for each other, as well as for marriage in later years, particularly after the passing of a partner to prevent feeling second best. Also, remarriage discourages jealousy of former partners.

Safed Pukhraj stone should be energized before wearing it to obtain the desired effect.

tabs.tab2_description:
Although White Sapphire gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits, it is highly recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing White Sapphire. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Sahasrara Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those looking for relief from stress, peace of mind and calmness.

One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone. This gemstone blesses with a soothing feeling and relaxing effect. You can take advantage of our expert advice on the suitability and compatibility of wearing this stone.

White Sapphire is recommended for individuals in the entertainment industry, fashion, film, airlines, saloons, photography, jewelry, hotel and hospitality, and the cosmetics industry. White Sapphire stone is also beneficial for singers, artists, event management professionals, people in creative fields, and those in public relations.

White Sapphire is the most powerful precious gemstone for counteracting the negative effects of a misplaced Neptune in the natal chart, such as mental escapism, confusion, difficulty differentiating between reality and fantasy, hypersensitivity to chemicals and drugs, and engaging in substance abuse, excessive daydreaming, or indulging in other addictive behaviors as a means of avoiding the challenges and harsh realities of life.

White Sapphire is ideal for spiritual seekers, those engaged in spiritual Sadhana, as well as those seeking material and marital stability and success.

Important Details:

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated White Sapphire gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated White Sapphire gemstones.

White Sapphire Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

The finest and larger, shiniest white sapphires are sourced from Sri Lanka and are commonly known as Ceylon white sapphires. Other nations, including Australia, Thailand, Burma, Madagascar, and Tanzania, also produce white sapphires, albeit in smaller quantities and of inferior quality compared to Sri Lanka.

Observe their Color:

White sapphires are transparent and colorless, not white. White sapphires are pure sapphires. These sapphires are one of the rarest types ever discovered. It resembles the clear, pristine waters of a river or ocean, which is ruled by Neptune, the god of the Seas.

Notice their Clarity:

The best quality white sapphires have extraordinary clarity and transparency. In direct sunlight, a completely untreated and natural white sapphire resembles a diamond in appearance because it exhibits excellent light reflection.

Examine their Inclusions:

White sapphires of average quality contain minor inclusions that are visible to the naked eye. These stones with no visible inclusions are extremely rare and valuable. Therefore, white sapphires with inclusions are widely accepted, traded, and utilized.

See their Shape:

The most common white sapphire shapes are oval, round, and cushion. These are frequently used for bracelets, pendants, and earrings. The crystalline structure of the sapphire is hexagonal. This allows it to be carved into an array of resilient shapes that can withstand regular wear under all kinds of climate conditions.

Check the Carats:

For White Sapphire of gem quality, the raw White Sapphire is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, White Sapphire weighing between 2 and 6 carats are appropriate for jewelry. Because White Sapphire is sold by weight, White Sapphire prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity White Sapphire has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated White Sapphire

Due to treatments the White Sapphire stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated White Sapphire do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate

It is recommended that you should purchase White Sapphire gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our White Sapphire are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy White Sapphire from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used White Sapphire gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated White Sapphire gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of White Sapphire is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity).

Color

The best white sapphires are colorless and do not get influenced by cosmic rays or color energies. However, most of the stones found have a pale brown or muddy color. Only about 10% of the white sapphires mined are colorless and qualify as the original, best-quality shimmering white sapphires.

Cut

The best quality white sapphires have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, and saturation. Note that a white sapphire in a round or oval shape is more budget-friendly than a square one, as the shaping or cutting process for the former is relatively cheaper and causes minimum wastage.

Carat

White Sapphire of 2 – 6 carat is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger White Sapphire are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of White Sapphire rises as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity

Minor inclusions visible to the naked eye are common in white sapphires. These stones are extremely rare and valuable because they have no visible inclusions. As a result, inclusions in white sapphires are widely accepted, traded, and used. The best white sapphires have the fewest inclusions and the highest clarity.

Dealers deal in white sapphires that are synthetic to natural but are treated/heated and colour enhanced, so you must buy only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputable lab.

White Sapphire gemstone Price

White Sapphire market value is affected by a variety of quality factors, such as origin, color, clarity, cut, size, certification, etc., which contribute to the gemstone's wide price variation. First, the price of a sapphire is determined by its carat, or weight. The larger the stone, the more difficult it is to find rough material of that size, which increases the cost of the finished white sapphire gemstone.

The price of a sapphire also depends on its clarity. Similar to diamonds, white sapphires may contain inclusions or minute flaws, although white sapphires typically have higher clarity than rubies. Lastly, the cost of a white sapphire gemstone is contingent on its place of origin. White sapphires are widespread, but valuable ones are exceedingly rare. Sri Lanka has been a major supplier of white sapphire gemstones suitable for jewelry.

Lab-created White Sapphire is more than common in the gemstone market as it happens with diamonds, so buy White Sapphire from a trusted reputed jeweler or gemstone dealer. It is also very important to avoid heated or treated white sapphire gemstones.

When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. White Sapphire has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated White Sapphire stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated White Sapphire gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 91,960 to INR 3,71,640 (USD 1.149 to USD 4.645).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic White Sapphire?

The best way to check the authenticity of White Sapphire is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our White Sapphire are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the White Sapphire carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a White Sapphire is genuine. Lab-created (fake) White Sapphire have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural White Sapphire, but if you find flaws, then your White Sapphire is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created White Sapphire are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural White Sapphire. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the White Sapphire, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your White Sapphire from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the White Sapphire. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the White Sapphire. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

White Sapphire Cleaning & Maintenance

Due to their lack of color, “white” gems such as white sapphires tend to become cloudy more quickly than colored gems. However, regular cleaning at home is a simple and quick way to combat a cloudy appearance.

The safest and simplest method for cleaning white sapphire is to use warm soapy water and a gem cleaning cloth. Once set in jewelry, use a soft paint brush to clean the setting thoroughly.

To keep the pavilion's stone in pristine condition, it is necessary to keep it clean.

It is not necessary to use chemicals to clean white sapphire gemstone.
